description: Source code for a JSON-RPC client implementation handling request/response tracking, event subscription, and socket communication.

classes.name: request_msg_tracking_t
classes.description: Structure to track individual RPC request messages, including sequence, buffer, response status, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: event_tracking_t
classes.description: Structure to track event subscriptions, including event name, notification type, and callback.

methods.name: json_hal_client_init
methods.description: Initializes the JSON-RPC client with configuration from a specified file.

methods.name: json_hal_client_run
methods.description: Starts the client socket thread to handle communication.

methods.name: json_hal_client_terminate
methods.description: Gracefully terminates the client, freeing resources and stopping threads.

methods.name: json_hal_client_subscribe_event
methods.description: Subscribes to an event with a specified callback, event path, and notification type.

methods.name: json_hal_is_client_connected
methods.description: Checks if the client is currently connected.

methods.name: json_hal_get_result_status
methods.description: Extracts the status (success/failure) from a JSON response object.

methods.name: json_hal_get_total_param_count
methods.description: Returns the total number of parameters in a JSON message.

methods.name: json_hal_client_send_and_get_reply
methods.description: Sends a JSON request and waits for a reply with default timeout.

methods.name: json_hal_client_send_and_get_reply_with_timeout
methods.description: Sends a JSON request and waits for a reply with specified timeout.

methods.name: json_hal_get_request_header
methods.description: Creates a JSON request header with specified action name and unique request ID.
